name: Wakaba (若葉, "Young Leaf")
concept: An Operative-class Frame — pure precision violence, the one thing about Susumu that isn't circuitous. Finds the exact seam in a Claimant's hide the same way he finds the exact hole in an argument.
notes: DRAFT — proposed 2026-08-22 at Ingram's direct request, open to full revision. Grounded in GM Core pg. 121-124's real level-12 tables, following the guidance's own explicit Operative example ('a moderate attack bonus and extreme damage might fit a creature that's more like an operative'): attack Moderate (+24), damage Extreme (3d12+19, avg 38) — the same tier pairing as Suzukaze's Solarian, but reached for a different in-fiction reason (precision picking the one real gap, not a striker's raw swing). AC/HP Moderate (32/210). Perception bumped to High (25, not the uniform Moderate 22 used elsewhere in this batch) since Operative's real class identity is built around spotting/exploiting openings — the one deliberate deviation from this batch's otherwise-uniform Perception baseline, not an oversight.
